title: Pass. Just a plain foam pillow
text:
Pass. Just a plain foam pillow. I'm a pillow princess and I expect a lot from my pillows, especially when they are priced close to a hundred bucks. This is just a basic foam pillow with ventilation holes in the foam. There's absolutely nothing unique or new n this pillow. It has a low profile, but can get flat under your head - it doesn't support well.

I definitely prefer my talalay shredded latex pillows to this. Three out of five nights with the Leesa pillow, I woke up and had to change pillows in the middle of the night. The late pillows are more adjustable and hold my head comfortably all night. And....they are certainly more budget friendly.
